name: Google Papillion

timeline.event: Land clearing begins for Building 1 of expansion.
Building 2 under construction. Building 3 begins construction.
Building 1 assumed operational due to vapor from cooling towers. Building 2 4/7 cooling towers installed. Building 3 roof complete coverage but unfinished.
Building 2 assumed operational due to vapor from cooling towers. Building 3 5/7 cooling towers installed.
Building 4 shell mostly complete, Building 5 steel framing is underway.

sources.publisher: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers Hub (CC-BY)
sources.quote: Google Papillion: current power 237 MW; owner Google.

explain: Google Papillion is an operating AI data center in USA, NE, owned by google. Epoch AI estimates it draws 237 MW today and 284 MW when finished.
